mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recommendation_run (id, student_id, profile_snapshot_id, rule_version, status, generated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{studentId}, #{profileSnapshotId}, #{ruleVersion}, #{status}, #{generatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, student_id, profile_snapshot_id, rule_version, status, generated_at, created_at FROM recommendation_run WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, student_id, profile_snapshot_id, rule_version, status, generated_at, created_at FROM recommendation_run WHERE student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM recommendation_run WHERE student_id = #{studentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recommendation_result (id, run_id, direction_id, score, `rank`, confidence, reasons_json, strengths_json, gaps_json, semester_actions_json, feedback_json) VALUES (#{id}, #{runId}, #{directionId}, #{score}, #{rank}, #{confidence}, #{reasonsJson}, #{strengthsJson}, #{gapsJson}, #{semesterActionsJson}, #{feedbackJson})
mapper.select: SELECT id, run_id, direction_id, score, `rank`, confidence, reasons_json, strengths_json, gaps_json, semester_actions_json, feedback_json, created_at FROM recommendation_result WHERE run_id = #{runId} ORDER BY `rank` ASC

SELECT id, run_id, direction_id, score, `rank`, confidence, reasons_json, strengths_json, gaps_json, semester_actions_json, feedback_json, created_at FROM recommendation_result WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
